ideas.pitch: A graph-intelligence platform connecting local farmer producer organizations (FPOs) directly to regional buyers with predictive pricing and logistics routing.
ideas.title: KrishiGraph: AI-Powered Rural Supply Chain & Mandi Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph intelligence combined with local context, mirroring techniques used in winning fraud-detection and logistics platforms.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI document verification tool that extracts and validates land and identity records from regional Indian languages without relying on continuous high-speed internet.
ideas.title: BhashaVault: Offline-First Multilingual Document Verification for Rural Governance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves real infrastructural constraints in rural India with localized OCR and LLMs, making it highly relevant for national-level social impact judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated monitoring dashboard tracking groundwater depletion and agricultural water usage across districts using multi-spectral satellite imagery indices.
ideas.title: JalNetra: Satellite-Based Ground Water Level & Aquifer Stress Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies hard geospatial machine learning to environmental resource management, replicating the technical depth of recent runner-up projects.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition tracking and meal recommendation web app that optimizes traditional Indian regional diets for specific health outcomes and chronic conditions.
ideas.title: AyurNutri-Connect: Regional Diet & Clinical Nutrition Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven consumer health personalization workflows tailored specifically to Indian dietary habits and nutritional needs.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent academic companion that maps a student's current coursework and projects against active industry job descriptions to generate personalized micro-learning paths.
ideas.title: VidyarthiAgent: Multi-Agent Mentorship and Skill-Gap Analyzer for Tier-2/3 Colleges
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the student demographic attending Chitkara University by solving employability and skill-mapping challenges using robust multi-agent orchestration.
